units.english: You grew up on Earth, an overpopulated world with few opportunities. But you took a contract working for the Syndicate, and they gave you a place to live, enough to eat, and a decent wage off of Earth. Afterward you moved to Antipode, a cheap frontier world, but found that it wasn't much better than Earth. Fed up, you used what you had left to travel to Delve, the closest planet with a shipyard...
units.italian: Sei cresciuto sulla Terra, un mondo sovrappopolato con poche opportunità. Ma hai firmato un contratto per lavorare al servizio del Sindacato, e loro ti hanno dato un posto dove vivere, da mangiare a sufficienza e un salario decoroso lontano dalla Terra. Dopo te ne sei andato ad Antipode, un mondo di frontiera economico, ma hai scoperto che non era molto meglio della Terra. Esasperato, hai usato quel che ti restava per viaggiare fino a Delve, il pianeta più vicino con un cantiere navale...

units.english: This is a more difficult start, with larger daily repayments.
units.italian: È un inizio più difficile, con rate giornaliere più alte.

units.english: Bought a pilot's license and a ship, but had to take out a crushing mortgage. One last greedy stab by the Syndicate before I'm free.
units.italian: Ho comprato una licenza di pilota e una nave, ma ho dovuto accendere un mutuo schiacciante. Un'ultima stoccata del Sindacato, avida come sempre, prima della mia libertà.

units.english: Hundreds of years ago, the independent territories in different parts of human space agreed to join together into a single democratic government, with Earth as its capital. The rise of the Republic ushered in a long period of peace and prosperity in human history.
units.italian: Centinaia di anni fa i territori indipendenti sparsi nello spazio umano accettarono di unirsi in un unico governo democratico, con la Terra come capitale. L'ascesa della Repubblica inaugurò un lungo periodo di pace e di prosperità nella storia umana.

units.id: conversation:syndicate intro|Representation in the Republic Parliament is based on population. That means that some individual "Paradise Worlds" have more representatives than entire regions of space like the Dirt Belt that are more sparsely settled.|197|0
units.english: Representation in the Republic Parliament is based on population. That means that some individual "Paradise Worlds" have more representatives than entire regions of space like the Dirt Belt that are more sparsely settled.
units.italian: La rappresentanza in Parlamento repubblicano si basa sulla popolazione. Questo significa che alcuni singoli "Mondi del Paradiso" hanno più rappresentanti di intere regioni come il Dirt Belt, dove la popolazione è più rada.

units.english: The Syndicate is a megacorporation, the largest employer in human space. People who cannot find steady work elsewhere flock to the Syndicate factory worlds, where they are almost guaranteed to find a job. Although the Syndicate is technically part of the Republic, Syndicate worlds are governed directly by the corporation.
units.italian: Il Sindacato è una megacorporazione, il più grande datore di lavoro dello spazio umano. Chi non trova un lavoro stabile altrove accorre ai mondi-fabbrica del Sindacato, dove un impiego è quasi garantito. Sebbene il Sindacato faccia tecnicamente parte della Repubblica, i suoi mondi sono governati direttamente dalla corporazione.

units.id: conversation:syndicate intro|The Syndicate is a central part of the Republic's economy, but they are also well known for selling shoddy products and for doing damage to the environment on the worlds they control. Their treatment of workers is questionable, and their opposition to organized labor is legendary. Some Syndicate factory towns have even been accused of human rights abuses.|199|0
units.english: The Syndicate is a central part of the Republic's economy, but they are also well known for selling shoddy products and for doing damage to the environment on the worlds they control. Their treatment of workers is questionable, and their opposition to organized labor is legendary. Some Syndicate factory towns have even been accused of human rights abuses.
units.italian: Il Sindacato è una parte centrale dell'economia repubblicana, ma è anche noto per vendere prodotti scadenti e per danneggiare l'ambiente dei mondi che controlla. Il trattamento riservato ai lavoratori è discutibile, e la sua opposizione al sindacalismo è leggendaria. Alcune cittadine-fabbrica del Sindacato sono state persino accusate di violazioni dei diritti umani.

units.english: In poorer and more remote star systems, where the Navy seldom patrols, pirate attacks on merchant ships are frequent. Pirates are also known to attack large, unguarded convoys of freighters even in more populated areas. Most pirate fleets come from lawless worlds on the outskirts of human space.
units.italian: Nei sistemi stellari più poveri e remoti, dove la Marina pattuglia di rado, gli attacchi pirata alle navi mercantili sono frequenti. I pirati sono noti anche per attaccare grandi convogli di mercantili senza scorta in zone più popolate. La maggior parte delle flotte pirata viene da mondi senza legge ai margini dello spazio umano.

units.id: conversation:syndicate intro|Delve is unlike any planet you've ever been on: the entire spaceport is built into a colossal mountain cave, one side exposed to the open air. The beams and buildings making up the port dwarf the pitiful structures of Antipode, yet feel distinct from the crushing urban landscapes of Earth.|202|0
units.english: Delve is unlike any planet you've ever been on: the entire spaceport is built into a colossal mountain cave, one side exposed to the open air. The beams and buildings making up the port dwarf the pitiful structures of Antipode, yet feel distinct from the crushing urban landscapes of Earth.
units.italian: Delve non assomiglia a nessun pianeta su cui sia mai stato: l'intero spazioporto è scavato in una colossale caverna montana, con un lato aperto all'aria. Le travi e gli edifici che formano il porto fanno sembrare misere le strutture di Antipode, eppure sono lontani dai paesaggi urbani opprimenti della Terra.

units.id: conversation:syndicate intro|	You hand the last of your credits to the captain that brought you here. Before she leaves, she gives you some advice. "Just a heads up: if you don't feel like dying early, head north after launching. South of here is nothing but uninhabited systems and pirates. You wouldn't last long in any ship you could afford." You thank her for the ride and advice before parting ways.|203|0
units.english: You hand the last of your credits to the captain that brought you here. Before she leaves, she gives you some advice. "Just a heads up: if you don't feel like dying early, head north after launching. South of here is nothing but uninhabited systems and pirates. You wouldn't last long in any ship you could afford." You thank her for the ride and advice before parting ways.
units.italian: Consegni gli ultimi crediti al capitano che ti ha portato qui. Prima di andarsene, ti dà qualche consiglio. "Un avvertimento: se non hai voglia di morire presto, dopo il decollo punta a nord. A sud di qui non c'è altro che sistemi disabitati e pirati. Non dureresti a lungo con una nave che puoi permetterti." La ringrazi per il passaggio e per il consiglio, poi vi separate.

units.id: conversation:syndicate intro|	You stop by the shipyard first to see what they have. You're noticed by a salesman who scoffs as you approach, perhaps due to the shabbiness of your clothes compared to those around you. You ask him what it would take to purchase a ship here. He mentions the necessity of a pilot's license before beginning his spiel about all the cheapest models, but you cut him short and say that's all you needed.|204|0
units.english: You stop by the shipyard first to see what they have. You're noticed by a salesman who scoffs as you approach, perhaps due to the shabbiness of your clothes compared to those around you. You ask him what it would take to purchase a ship here. He mentions the necessity of a pilot's license before beginning his spiel about all the cheapest models, but you cut him short and say that's all you needed.
units.italian: Prima passi dal cantiere per vedere che cosa hanno. Ti nota un venditore che sbuffa quando ti avvicini, forse per la trasandatezza dei tuoi vestiti rispetto a quelli intorno a te. Gli chiedi che cosa servirebbe per comprare una nave qui. Ti accenna alla necessità di una licenza di pilota prima di cominciare il suo sproloquio sui modelli più economici, ma lo interrompi e dici che ti bastava sapere quello.

units.id: conversation:syndicate intro|	Luckily, the bank isn't very busy at the moment. One of the tellers sizes you up as you enter. "What can we help you with?" he asks with unrestrained glee. You say you're in need of a loan to buy a starship; 600,000 credits should be enough to cover the license and the ship. After you hand over your Syndicated Systems Account information and scan your fingerprint, the teller returns with a piece of paper.|205|0
units.english: Luckily, the bank isn't very busy at the moment. One of the tellers sizes you up as you enter. "What can we help you with?" he asks with unrestrained glee. You say you're in need of a loan to buy a starship; 600,000 credits should be enough to cover the license and the ship. After you hand over your Syndicated Systems Account information and scan your fingerprint, the teller returns with a piece of paper.
units.italian: Per fortuna la banca al momento non è molto affollata. Uno dei cassieri ti misura da capo a piedi mentre entri. "Come possiamo aiutarla?" chiede con una gioia sfrenata. Dici che ti serve un prestito per comprare un'astronave; 600.000 crediti dovrebbero bastare per la licenza e per la nave. Dopo aver consegnato i dati del tuo conto Syndicated Systems e aver scansionato l'impronta digitale, il cassiere torna con un foglio di carta.

units.id: conversation:syndicate intro|	"Lucky for you, rates are great right now!" You glance at the paper: the daily interest rate is 0.5%, meaning the daily payments are 3,580 credits for a whole year. If you don't pay off any of your loan early, you'll have paid 706,571 credits in interest, more than the 600,000 loan itself. "Just sign here." The teller grins.|206|0
units.english: "Lucky for you, rates are great right now!" You glance at the paper: the daily interest rate is 0.5%, meaning the daily payments are 3,580 credits for a whole year. If you don't pay off any of your loan early, you'll have paid 706,571 credits in interest, more than the 600,000 loan itself. "Just sign here." The teller grins.
units.italian: "Per tua fortuna, i tassi adesso sono ottimi!" Dai un'occhiata al foglio: il tasso d'interesse giornaliero è dello 0,5%, il che significa rate giornaliere di 3.580 crediti per un anno intero. Se non restituisci in anticipo nessuna parte del prestito, avrai pagato 706.571 crediti di interessi, più dei 600.000 del prestito stesso. "Firmi qui." Il cassiere sorride.

units.id: conversation:syndicate intro|	The interest is terrible, but there's nothing you can do about it. You sign your name:|207|0
units.english: The interest is terrible, but there's nothing you can do about it. You sign your name:
units.italian: Gli interessi sono tremendi, ma non puoi farci niente. Firmi il tuo nome:

units.id: conversation:syndicate intro|	After leaving the bank, you spend an hour waiting in line to apply for a pilot's license. The process is oddly simple, and by the time it's done, you're left with 480,000 credits. You can't shake the feeling that the Syndicate is playing you again.|209|0
units.english: After leaving the bank, you spend an hour waiting in line to apply for a pilot's license. The process is oddly simple, and by the time it's done, you're left with 480,000 credits. You can't shake the feeling that the Syndicate is playing you again.
units.italian: Dopo aver lasciato la banca, passi un'ora in fila per richiedere una licenza di pilota. La procedura è stranamente semplice, e quando è finita ti restano 480.000 crediti. Non riesci a scuoterti di dosso la sensazione che il Sindacato ti stia di nuovo prendendo in giro.

units.id: conversation:syndicate intro|	You return to the shipyard, this time with a credit chip in your hand to draw the attention of the salesman. "Welcome back! I hope we can find you the perfect model," he says. The shipyard is full of ships that you can't buy, but the salesman finds three models within your price range: an interceptor, a light freighter, and a transport ship. Which one you choose will determine your future...|210|0
units.english: You return to the shipyard, this time with a credit chip in your hand to draw the attention of the salesman. "Welcome back! I hope we can find you the perfect model," he says. The shipyard is full of ships that you can't buy, but the salesman finds three models within your price range: an interceptor, a light freighter, and a transport ship. Which one you choose will determine your future...
units.italian: Torni al cantiere, questa volta con un gettone di credito in mano per attirare l'attenzione del venditore. "Eccoti di nuovo! Spero che possiamo trovarti il modello perfetto," dice. Il cantiere è pieno di navi che non puoi comprare, ma il venditore trova tre modelli nel tuo budget: un intercettore, un mercantile leggero e una nave da trasporto. Quale sceglierai determinerà il tuo futuro...
